After breakfast, depart for the upper stretches of the Limay River. Its clear water and varied currents offer opportunities to fish for rainbow and brown trout. The guides choose the section of river according to water levels and fish movements.

Depending on the conditions, you may fish with dry flies, nymphs or streamers. The full-day outing combines fishing with a float downstream, with a stop for lunch on the riverbank.

The Lakeshore Chalet itinerary includes five such full-day outings. The fishing stretches vary from day to day, and the cost of all five trips is included in the overall tour price.

After breakfast, take a bus up to Machu Picchu. The ascent takes approximately 30 minutes.
Machu Picchu is an ancient Inca city, a maze of skilfully built stone temples, houses and fountains. It stands on a mountain ridge between two peaks, surrounded by striking Andean scenery.
For a long time, the city lay hidden beneath dense vegetation until the American explorer Hiram Bingham discovered it in 1911.
On arrival, a guide will take you through this legendary archaeological complex.

On arrival at Aguas Calientes station, take a shared bus up to the entrance to Machu Picchu. Enjoy a private guided tour of the sacred Inca city lasting approximately 2.5 hours with a Russian-speaking guide, exploring the terraces, ancient passages and temples, including the Intihuatana sundial and other sacred sites.

After the visit, enjoy afternoon tea at the restaurant of the Belmond Sanctuary Lodge hotel beside the entrance to Machu Picchu. Then return aboard the Hiram Bingham train with dinner served on board, arrive at Poroy station and transfer to Cusco.

The experience begins with a guided journey through the jungle, where the guide talks about the national park. A short walk then leads to a purpose-built riverside platform, where the boat ride towards the falls begins. The boat approaches the cascades closely, amid spray, the roar of rushing water and green hillsides.

This excursion is included in the main day's itinerary. Private arrangements for the overall route do not automatically mean a private boat; the format of the boat portion is agreed at the time of booking.
